title: Explore our maps and discover Nomad Wars
summary: Browse 21 arena previews in 3D, including three maps for our upcoming Nomad Wars mode.
body:
The map catalogue is now available at /maps. Explore 18 existing arenas and three Nomad Wars maps in 3D or from above, and share a direct link to your favourite map.

Nomad Wars is coming soon. Its preview explains moving safe zones, two passes around the arena, shared supplies, public forges and the central final battle. The mode is not open for public play yet, and its rules may change following playtesting.

Read the preview at /nomad-wars, or in French at /fr/nomad-wars.
